← Project index N° 03 — Healthcare / Housing

Healthcare / Housing · Muzaffarpur, Bihar

Palliative Care & Housing

A palliative-care environment organised around gardens, courtyards and a low, curving architectural form. Clinical spaces and places for everyday life share a close connection with the landscape. Staff accommodation forms a related part of the campus studies.

Location
Muzaffarpur, Bihar
Category
Healthcare / Housing
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm
01

Building around the trees

The concept develops a curving footprint within the planted site, with gardens between the building wings.

02

Care at ground level

The plan brings rooms, shared spaces and sheltered circulation around a series of open courts.

Drawings & studies
03

The section through care

Low profiles and shaded circulation maintain a close relationship between interiors and outdoor space.

Drawings & studies
04

The everyday experience

Daylight, views and accessible garden edges give the shared spaces a domestic scale.

05

Support buildings

Nurses’ accommodation and administration extend the campus programme beyond the care building.

Drawings & studies
06

Campus housing

The housing proposal groups residential blocks around landscaped shared spaces.

07

Housing typologies

Unit and cluster studies explore repeatable residential arrangements alongside the campus landscape.
